field.role: Soft-owner ID/handle to the history object

format_evidence.supports: Group 350 is the soft-owner ID/handle to the history object; the AcDb3dSolid subclass carries this reference.

mapping_policy: For a nonzero R2007+ 3DSOLID history handle, use the configured reference resolver when present; otherwise use remapObjectHandle. Reject a zero or NoHandle result for a nonzero source. Preserve the existing explicit group-350 zero value when the source has no history handle.

validation.input: Generated in-memory DRW_ModelerGeometry with eType E3DSOLID; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: Exact group-350 output under resolver precedence and source-handle-remap fallback
Historyless solid retains the existing group-350 zero carrier even with a resolver configured
Unresolved resolver target refuses the record and preserves the destination
Corrected target serializes through a fresh writer after low-level dxfRW sticky failure

qualification_limits: Generated low-level transport only; it does not prove that the history target exists, has a valid target role, or is reachable in the source object graph.
Does not establish the DWG entity-to-history association, recursive ACDS closure, ACIS/B-rep semantics, physical producer breadth, native consumer behavior, or support-claim eligibility.
